description: Ciclovia Tirrenica is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. La ciclovia Tirrenica è una delle 10 ciclovie del Sistema Nazionale delle Ciclovie Turistiche, proposte dal Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti (Mit) e dal Ministero dei Beni Artistici, Culturali e Turistici (Mibact), che parte da Ventimiglia, dal confine di Stato con la Francia, e termina a Roma. Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are carte-tematiche, eu, open-data, regionale, reti-di-trasporto. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
